entities.summary: Ondřej Kaše is a Czech professional ice hockey player who is a forward for HC Litvínov of the Czech Extraliga (ELH). He has previously played in the National Hockey League (NHL) with the Anaheim Ducks, Boston Bruins, Toronto Maple Leafs and Carolina Hurricanes. Kase was selected by the Ducks in the seventh round, 205th overall, during the 2014 NHL entry draft.
